description: Respond to an intro. WHEN: accept, decline, or block a pending intro addressed to you. Differs from arena_intro_request (create) and arena_dm_send (message after accept). Only the target may respond (server-side auth). Accept opens an intro DM through the existing DM flow. Credit: Dead Brands. Example: arena_intro_respond {"intro_id":"<intro_id>","action":"<action>"}
